description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AttendanceRecordAPI, testing features such as retrieving, updating, and deleting attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes test data providers, setup for workflow state machines, and mock service registrations.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AttendanceRecordAPI endpoints and behaviors within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single attendance record via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an attendance record via the API.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow states allowing users to modify their own attendance records.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow states allowing supervisors to modify attendance records of their subordinates.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete operation is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that validation rules for delete operation are not implemented.
